objective: Find and prove, from ticket A and the block lemma, a short native rule that recovers the atoms and the directed tree of a Fano tree from creation; state its conditions, and test it on random trees, including where the conditions fail.
status: Proved: twins (lines creating at each other and at the same other lines) are the atoms, and receivers' footprints give every cut with its direction, in every Fano tree whose atoms have at most four cuts (condition N); exhaustive up to five atoms, 1,550 random trees; computed: through plane glue the rule does not extend as stated
title: Reading the tree from creation
